question: Which university faculty members' salaries are closest to the average salary for their respective ranks? Please provide the ranks, first names, last names, and salaries.university
sql:
WITH rank_averages AS (
    SELECT FacRank, AVG(FacSalary) as avg_salary
    FROM university_faculty
    GROUP BY FacRank
),
closest AS (
    SELECT 
        f.FacRank,
        f.FacFirstName,
        f.FacLastName,
        f.FacSalary,
        r.avg_salary,
        ABS(f.FacSalary - r.avg_salary) as diff
    FROM university_faculty f
    JOIN rank_averages r ON f.FacRank = r.FacRank
)
SELECT FacRank, FacFirstName, FacLastName, FacSalary
FROM (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY FacRank ORDER BY diff ASC) as rn
    FROM closest
) ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY FacRank
